items.title: Sensex, Nifty in focus: Hormuz tensions, crude oil, Fed minutes among key triggers
items.description: With the earnings season largely behind them, investors are likely to track the Fed minutes, foreign fund flows and Chinese economic data for fresh market cues

items.title: Broader indices end mixed; midcaps extend rally for third week
items.description: Going ahead, the immediate resistance for Nifty is placed in the 24500-24550 zone. Any sustainable move above this zone could result in Nifty extending its pullback towards 24700, followed by 24850 in the short term, says Sudeep Shah, Head - Technical and Derivatives Research at SBI Securities.
